eraModifiers.text: Wilder weather: flood repairs cost 3 materials, and a storm can damage 2 exposed buildings.
Long winters: homes need 1 more heat on winter nights.

flood.name: King tide
flood.summary: salt water over the mudflat and low saltmarsh
flood.description: The year's highest tide covers the mudflat and the saltmarsh beside it. Buildings there that aren't salt-tolerant are disabled for the season and cost 2 materials to repair. Crofts it reaches are salted: half their food for 2 seasons; then crofts on saltmarsh make 1 more food for the rest of the year. Sea walls keep it off tiles within 2.

fog.name: Sea fog
fog.description: Fog rolls in off the sea: every solar canopy makes 1 less energy each day, and every cistern catches 1 water.

storm.name: Gale
storm.summary: wind rises; two exposed buildings may be damaged
storm.description: Wind rises; two exposed buildings (on a headland, or out at sea) are disabled for the season unless something shelters them.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.summary: solar is weak; homes need heat at night
freeze.description: Solar is weak, homes need heat, wind is strong.

combos.name: Quiet Spire
combos.text: A pollinator meadow next to a wind spire cancels the spire's Harmony penalty.
combos.hint: Flowers soften the hum of the wind spires.

combos.name: Kiln Warmth
combos.text: A kiln next to a heat well charges it for free: 1 heat each run.
combos.hint: A kiln's waste heat can be kept for winter.

combos.name: Green Doorstep
combos.text: A cottage next to meadow or woodland: +1 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: People like to live near green land.

combos.name: Bath Loop
combos.text: Kiln or heat well → heat → bathhouse → grey water → reed bed, in a chain of neighbours. It closes when the bathhouse takes its heat from the kiln or well next to it and the reed bed next to it cleans grey water. Once it runs, the kiln makes +1 materials and the reed bed +1 biomass for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Warm the bath with a neighbour's spare heat; let reeds clean what it lets out.

combos.name: Village Green
combos.text: A Commons Plaza ringed by 6 buildings of at least 3 kinds: +2 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: A gathering place, surrounded on every side by a varied neighbourhood.

combos.name: Sun Terrace
combos.text: 3 solar canopies in a row, all on hills: each makes +1 day energy every season.
combos.hint: Panels stepping in a straight line along the high ground.

combos.name: Keyhole Garden
combos.text: A composter with 3 farms next to it: its compost doubles.
combos.hint: A heap at the heart of the beds.

combos.name: Hearth Square
combos.text: A bathhouse, a Commons Plaza and a cottage, each touching the other two: +5 wellbeing in winter.
combos.hint: Somewhere warm to gather when it's cold.

combos.name: Agrivoltaic Field
combos.text: A solar canopy built over a farm merges with it into an Agrivoltaic Field, one building on one tile with the farm's worker: the canopy's energy (3 / 4 / 2 / 1 by day), the farm's food minus 1 (silt after that), and no loss in a low river.
combos.hint: Panels high enough to farm beneath.

combos.name: Treehouse Commons
combos.text: A cottage next to 2 woodland tiles becomes a Treehouse Commons: +2 wellbeing each season instead of +1.
combos.hint: A home among the trees.

combos.name: Kitchen Loop
combos.text: Croft → scraps and biomass → composter → compost → croft. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (crofts food, the composter compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Put a composter among working crofts.

combos.name: Gas Loop
combos.text: Croft biomass → digester → night power, digestate back to the crofts. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (crofts food, the digester compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: A digester fed by the crofts beside it.

combos.name: Shellfish Beds
combos.text: An oyster reef next to a kelp farm: +1 food each.
combos.hint: Shellfish and weed grow best together.

combos.name: Lee of the Dunes
combos.text: Dune grass shelters the buildings beside it: gales can't damage them.
combos.hint: Marram grass holds the sand, and the wind.

combos.name: Kelp Loop
combos.text: Kelp farm → kelp → composter → compost → croft, in a chain of neighbours. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (food, or compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: The sea can feed the land, if the heap stands between them.

combos.name: Sweetwater Loop
combos.text: Tide turbine → energy → desalinator → fresh water → greenhouse, in a chain of neighbours. Once it runs, the greenhouse makes +1 food for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Turn the tide into water a greenhouse can drink.

combos.name: Shore Loop
combos.text: Bathhouse → grey water → oyster reef → clean water → kelp farm, in a chain of neighbours. It closes when the reef cleans the bath's water. Once it runs, the reef and the kelp make +1 food.
combos.hint: Oysters clean what the bath lets out.

combos.name: Breakwater
combos.text: 3 sea walls in a straight line: +2 Harmony, and gales can't damage anything within 1 tile of them.
combos.hint: Walls along the shore, end to end.

combos.name: Dune Line
combos.text: 4 dune grass in a straight line: +1 Harmony, and gales can't damage anything within 2 tiles of them.
combos.hint: A long ridge of marram against the sea wind.

combos.name: Wind Ridge
combos.text: 3 wind spires in a row on headlands: each makes +1 energy in every slot.
combos.hint: Blades along the high ground over the sea.

combos.name: Machair Croft
combos.text: A croft next to 2 dune grass becomes a Machair Croft: +1 food, and the king tide doesn't salt it.
combos.hint: Sand and grass make the best of the shore's soil.

combos.name: Kelp Forest
combos.text: A kelp farm next to 2 oyster reefs becomes a Kelp Forest: +1 food, +1 Harmony, and gales can't damage it.
combos.hint: Weed among the reefs grows tall.

combos.name: Rock Pool
combos.text: A salvage yard by the shore whose ruin is empty may become a Rock Pool instead of a Rewilded Ruin: +2 Harmony, 1 food a season, and its worker is free. You choose.
combos.hint: Where the old harbour was, the sea moves back in.

combos.name: Rewilded Ruin
combos.text: A salvage yard whose ruin is empty becomes a Rewilded Ruin: +2 Harmony, and its worker is free. By the shore, choose it or a Rock Pool.
combos.hint: What happens when nothing is left to salvage?

tunings.name: Mirror Film
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 energy in winter.

tunings.name: Night Shift
tunings.text: Workshops get a 3rd run, on night energy only.

tunings.name: Hive Mind
tunings.text: Apiaries reach 2 tiles.

tunings.name: Kiln Loop
tunings.text: Kilns recover their own heat: each firing needs 1 energy instead of 2.

tunings.name: Terraced Fields
tunings.text: Floodplain farms make +1 food in summer and autumn.

tunings.name: Brighter Panels
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 day energy in spring and summer.

tunings.name: Balanced Blades
tunings.text: Wind spires make +1 energy by day and night in summer.

tunings.name: Deeper Wheels
tunings.text: River wheels make +1 energy by day and night in summer, when the river is low.

tunings.name: Insulated Homes
tunings.text: Cottages and treehouses need no heat on winter nights.

tunings.name: Bigger Larders
tunings.text: Cottages store 5 more food.

tunings.name: Loft Rooms
tunings.text: Cottages house 1 more citizen.

tunings.name: Lean Workshops
tunings.text: Each workshop run needs 1 energy instead of 2.

tunings.name: Deep Cells
tunings.text: Cell banks hold 2 more energy.

tunings.name: Hot Compost
tunings.text: A full composter makes 3 compost instead of 2.

tunings.name: Reading Rooms
tunings.text: Seedbank libraries make +1 knowledge every season.

tunings.name: Busy Bees
tunings.text: Each apiary helps 1 more neighbouring farm or orchard.

tunings.name: Festival Nights
tunings.text: A powered Commons Plaza gives +1 more wellbeing.

tunings.name: Heat Recovery
tunings.text: Each kiln firing sends 1 more heat to a neighbouring heat well.

tunings.name: Deeper Fins
tunings.text: Tide turbines make +1 energy in summer, day and night.

tunings.name: Salt Cure
tunings.text: Salted crofts lose a third of their food, not half.

tunings.name: Storm Lashing
tunings.text: Wave buoys can't be damaged by gales.

tunings.name: Kelp Ropes
tunings.text: Kelp farms make +1 food in summer and autumn.

tunings.name: Dry Stone
tunings.text: Sea walls keep the king tide off tiles within 3, not 2.

tunings.name: Bright Lamp
tunings.text: Lighthouses shelter everything within 3 tiles from gales, not 2.

tunings.name: Tide Pools
tunings.text: Oyster reefs make +1 food in winter.

tunings.name: Driftwood
tunings.text: Beachcombing yards make +1 salvage every season.

charters.name: Repair Culture
charters.text: Salvage ×2: each salvage yard makes 6 a season from the same ruin. Workshops turn 2 clutter into 2 materials.

charters.name: Night Market
charters.text: +2 wellbeing each season the night slot is fully powered.

charters.name: Rewilders
charters.text: Tree nurseries improve a neighbouring tile 2 steps a season; pollinator meadows give +1 more Harmony.

charters.name: Shore Keepers
charters.text: The king tide does no damage; oyster reefs make +1 food.

charters.name: Storm Wardens
charters.text: Gales damage one building, not two.

visions.name: Restore the Shore
visions.text: Make half the coast's healable land meadow or woodland.

visions.name: Lantern of the Shore
visions.text: Go a full year, spring to winter, with 30 or more citizens and no shortfall in any slot.

visions.name: Thriving Commons
visions.text: Reach 50 citizens with wellbeing 70 or more.

projects.name: Green Terraces
projects.text: Compost worked into the worst ground: when finished, the 8 least healthy tiles of land each improve one step.

projects.name: Biochar Beds
projects.text: Biomass buried as charcoal feeds the soil for good: +6 Harmony from then on.

projects.name: Seed Vault
projects.text: The valley's seeds, catalogued and kept: +25 to the run's score.

projects.name: Festival Grounds
projects.text: A meadow stage for the turning seasons: +2 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: The Long Bridge
projects.text: A timber bridge across the whole reach: +40 to the run's score.

projects.name: Sky Garden
projects.text: Terraced gardens climbing the hills: +12 Harmony and +1 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: Gift to Root City
projects.text: Seed stock, tools and stories sent ahead: +6 Seeds when the run is sent home.

twists.name: Fair Weather
twists.text: No twist: the seasons as usual.

twists.name: Long Winter
twists.text: Homes need 4 more heat on winter nights, 3 more in autumn and 2 more in spring, and solar canopies make 1 less by day in autumn and winter. Heat is local: heat pumps, heat wells and solar thermal collectors warm only buildings within 2 tiles, and energy can't heat anything directly: homes left without a heat source go cold. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Wild Storms
twists.text: Storms can damage 3 buildings anywhere on open land, not just hills (woodland beside them still shelters them), the Mixed Grid can't stop them, and each repair costs 3 materials. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Steady Winds
twists.text: Wind spires make 1 more energy by day and night, but storms can damage 2 exposed buildings.

twists.name: Clear Skies
twists.text: Solar canopies make 1 more energy by day, but wind spires make 1 less, day and night.

twists.name: Lean Start
twists.text: The Sprout sets out with 5 materials, 4 food and 4 citizens. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Big Families
twists.text: Citizens arrive two at a time, but only when a season's harvest leaves 4 food spare after eating (usually 2).

twists.name: Scavengers' Shore
twists.text: Ruins hold 12 more salvage each (36 instead of 24), but every clutter costs 2 Harmony.

twists.name: Big Tides
twists.text: The king tide reaches a ring further inland, but tide turbines make 1 more energy by day and night.

twists.name: Becalmed
twists.text: A still year: wind spires make 1 less energy by day and night. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Fogbound
twists.text: Sea fog all year: solar canopies make 1 less energy by day in every season.

regions.name: The Coast
regions.text: The shore as it is: the sea to the east, mudflat and dunes along it, two headlands and a stream.

regions.name: Shingle Spit
regions.text: A narrow strip of land with the sea close on one side: more sea for turbines, buoys and kelp, and less land to build on.

regions.name: Saltmarsh Estuary
regions.text: A wide stream mouth: mudflat all along the shore and saltmarsh behind it. Rich ground for crofts and oysters, and more of it under the king tide.

regions.name: Sea Cliffs
regions.text: Rocky headlands all along the shore and little mudflat: wind everywhere and gales with it. The Graft is one tier higher.

regions.name: Drowned Harbour
regions.text: The old harbour town: ruins all along the shore, more of them and fuller (30 salvage each).

eraGoals.text: Go a full year, spring to winter, with no energy shortfall.

levels.name: Bitter Nights
levels.text: Homes need 1 more heat on winter nights.

levels.name: Quick Clutter
levels.text: Citizens make scraps faster: one for every 2 citizens instead of 3.

levels.name: Slow Healing
levels.text: Spreading compost takes 4 compost per step of healing instead of 2.

levels.name: Restless People
levels.text: The population grows only at wellbeing 70 or more, instead of 60.

levels.name: Cold Autumns
levels.text: Homes need 1 more heat on autumn nights.

levels.name: Rough Seasons
levels.text: Flood repairs cost 2 more materials, and storms can damage one more exposed building.

levels.name: Weary People
levels.text: Meeting every need no longer lifts wellbeing.

levels.name: High Hopes
levels.text: Civic life serves 10 fewer citizens before expectations cost wellbeing.
